industries.name: Healthcare providers and hospitals
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where clinicians and admin staff spend hours reading notes, filling payer forms and sorting claims instead of caring for patients.

examples.title: Discharge summary first draft
examples.bottleneck: Hospitalists write discharge summaries late in the day from scattered progress notes, medication lists and labs, so summaries are delayed and follow-up items get missed.
examples.data: Generate 30 synthetic inpatient stays (progress notes, medication list, lab results) with an LLM; no real patient data.
examples.approval: The attending physician edits and signs the summary before it goes to the patient or the next provider.
examples.measure: Clinician rating of 20 drafts for completeness and accuracy; number of missed follow-up items against a checklist.

examples.title: Prior authorization form filler
examples.bottleneck: Prior authorization staff copy diagnosis codes, past treatments and clinical justification from charts into payer forms by hand, which is slow and causes rework when fields are wrong.
examples.data: Generate 30 synthetic chart notes and a synthetic payer criteria sheet for one procedure, plus a blank sample prior auth form.
examples.approval: A prior auth specialist reviews every filled field and attaches evidence before submission.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 30 labeled charts; share of forms that needed no correction.

examples.title: Claim denial reason sorter
examples.bottleneck: Billers read denial codes and free-text remarks one by one to decide whether a claim needs coding fixes, missing documents or an appeal, so work queues back up.
examples.data: Generate 200 synthetic denial records (denial code, remark text, claim summary) with an LLM, labeled with the correct work queue.
examples.approval: A billing lead confirms the queue for any denial marked as an appeal before work starts.
examples.measure: Routing accuracy on 50 held-out denials; confusion matrix by queue.

examples.title: Nursing policy and procedure lookup
examples.bottleneck: Nurses search hundreds of policy PDFs on the intranet during a shift to find the current rule, for example line care or fall precautions, and often ask a colleague instead.
examples.data: Write or generate 25 synthetic hospital policy documents with version dates.
examples.approval: The policy owner reviews the answer set and the cited sections before the tool is shown to staff.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and citation correctness on 40 test questions; rate of 'I do not know' when the answer is not in the policies.

industries.name: MedTech and medical devices
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help in the document-heavy work of design controls, complaint handling, clinical evidence and supplier quality that regulators expect to be traceable.

examples.title: Device complaint intake and reportability flag
examples.bottleneck: Complaint handlers read emails and call notes, retype device, lot, event and patient details into the complaint system, and must judge quickly if the event may be reportable.
examples.data: Generate 50 synthetic complaint emails with an LLM, using public device event reports from the FDA MAUDE database as style reference.
examples.approval: A complaint specialist confirms every field and makes the final reportability decision.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 labeled emails; recall on emails labeled as potentially reportable.

examples.title: Requirements to verification trace checker
examples.bottleneck: Design engineers build the trace matrix between design inputs and verification tests by hand for the design history file, and gaps are often found late in a design review.
examples.data: Write a synthetic list of 60 design inputs and 70 verification test protocol summaries for a simple device such as a home blood pressure monitor.
examples.approval: The design engineer accepts or rejects each proposed link before the matrix is updated.
examples.measure: Precision and recall of proposed links against a hand-built trace matrix; number of true gaps found.

examples.title: Clinical evaluation literature screening
examples.bottleneck: Clinical affairs reviewers screen hundreds of abstracts by hand for the clinical evaluation report under EU MDR, deciding include or exclude and writing a reason for each.
examples.data: Pull 200 public abstracts from PubMed for one device type and label 100 of them include or exclude with a reason.
examples.approval: A clinical reviewer confirms every include or exclude decision and the reason before it enters the report.
examples.measure: Agreement with reviewer labels on 100 abstracts; number of relevant papers missed.

examples.title: Supplier corrective action request from inspection fails
examples.bottleneck: When incoming inspection rejects supplied components, quality engineers write the supplier corrective action request from inspection records, photos notes and drawings, which takes hours per case.
examples.data: Generate 20 synthetic incoming inspection nonconformance records for molded and machined parts, plus a synthetic supplier quality agreement.
examples.approval: A supplier quality engineer edits and approves the request before it is sent to the supplier.
examples.measure: Reviewer score on 20 drafts for correct defect description, requirement cited and requested containment; edit time per draft.

industries.name: Pharma and biotech
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where trained experts read long protocols, case reports and batch records to make decisions that must be documented.

examples.title: Trial eligibility pre-screen
examples.bottleneck: Site coordinators read long inclusion and exclusion criteria against each patient record by hand, so pre-screening is slow and eligible patients are missed.
examples.data: Use eligibility criteria from 5 public studies on ClinicalTrials.gov and generate 40 synthetic patient profiles.
examples.approval: The investigator or coordinator confirms eligibility before any patient is contacted.
examples.measure: Criterion-level agreement with hand labels on 40 profiles; false eligible rate.

examples.title: Adverse event case intake from call notes
examples.bottleneck: Safety staff read call center notes and emails to find adverse events and enter patient, reporter, product and event details into the safety database under strict timelines.
examples.data: Generate 60 synthetic call center notes with an LLM, using public adverse event records from openFDA as reference for fields.
examples.approval: A safety specialist confirms the case is valid and the fields are correct before the case is created.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 labeled notes; recall of notes that contain an adverse event.

examples.title: Batch record deviation summary
examples.bottleneck: QA reviewers read long batch records to find deviations and comments before release, and the summary for the release decision is written by hand.
examples.data: Generate 15 synthetic batch records as text with embedded deviations, operator comments and out-of-range readings.
examples.approval: A QA reviewer checks the summary against the batch record and makes the release decision.
examples.measure: Recall of planted deviations across 15 records; reviewer rating of summary accuracy.

examples.title: Medical information response from approved label
examples.bottleneck: Medical information staff answer repeat questions from doctors and pharmacists by searching label text and standard response documents, which is slow and inconsistent.
examples.data: Use 3 public drug labels from DailyMed and write 40 synthetic questions from healthcare professionals.
examples.approval: A medical information pharmacist approves each response before it is sent.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and citation to label section on 40 questions; rate of correct refusals for off-label questions.

industries.name: Banking and lending
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where analysts read documents and alerts to make decisions that regulators and auditors will later check.

examples.title: Loan income document extractor
examples.bottleneck: Loan processors key income and employer details from pay stubs and bank statements into the loan system by hand, causing delays and typing errors.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic pay stubs and bank statements as PDFs with fake names and numbers.
examples.approval: An underwriter verifies the extracted income figures before they are used in the decision.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 documents; share of documents that needed no correction.

examples.title: Customer complaint category and urgency
examples.bottleneck: Complaint teams read every complaint to assign product, issue and urgency, and complaints that hint at regulatory issues can sit in the wrong queue.
examples.data: Use a sample of public complaint narratives from the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database.
examples.approval: A complaints lead confirms the category for anything marked high risk before it is routed.
examples.measure: Accuracy of product and issue labels against the database labels on 300 complaints; recall on high risk items.

examples.title: AML alert explanation for investigators
examples.bottleneck: Investigators open each transaction monitoring alert, pull account history and write a narrative of why it looks suspicious or not, which takes a long time per alert.
examples.data: Generate synthetic accounts and 6 months of transactions with planted patterns such as structuring and rapid movement of funds.
examples.approval: The investigator decides whether to close the alert or escalate it; the model never decides.
examples.measure: Reviewer rating of 30 explanations for factual accuracy against the transactions; share of planted patterns correctly described.

examples.title: Small business credit memo first draft
examples.bottleneck: Credit analysts spend hours assembling the credit memo from financial statements, application notes and policy, before any real analysis starts.
examples.data: Generate 10 synthetic small business applications with 3 years of financial statements and a synthetic credit policy.
examples.approval: The credit officer edits the memo and makes the credit decision.
examples.measure: Ratio calculation accuracy on 10 memos; reviewer score for policy exceptions correctly called out.

industries.name: Insurance
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where claims and underwriting staff read unstructured submissions and policy wording to make the next decision.

examples.title: First notice of loss intake
examples.bottleneck: Claims intake staff read loss emails and call notes and retype policy number, date, location, cause and damage into the claims system.
examples.data: Generate 50 synthetic first notice of loss emails for auto and home claims.
examples.approval: A claims handler confirms the fields and coverage before the claim is set up.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 labeled emails; correct line of business rate.

examples.title: Broker submission appetite triage
examples.bottleneck: Commercial underwriters receive many broker submissions and spend time reading ones that are clearly outside appetite before reaching the good ones.
examples.data: Write a synthetic underwriting appetite guide and generate 80 synthetic broker submission emails with attachments as text.
examples.approval: An underwriter confirms any decline before the broker is told.
examples.measure: Accuracy of in, out and refer labels on 80 submissions; false decline rate.

examples.title: Policy wording answers for service agents
examples.bottleneck: Call center agents put customers on hold to search long policy wordings for coverage questions, and answers vary by agent.
examples.data: Write 3 synthetic homeowners policy wordings with endorsements and 40 synthetic customer questions.
examples.approval: Any answer that confirms or denies coverage for a specific claim is checked by a licensed adjuster.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and correct clause citation on 40 questions; correct refusal rate when the wording is unclear.

examples.title: Claim fraud indicator explanation
examples.bottleneck: Rules flag many claims for possible fraud, and special investigations staff must read each file to understand why it was flagged.
examples.data: Generate 100 synthetic claims with claim history, with planted indicators such as recent policy start or repeated addresses.
examples.approval: An investigator decides whether to open a case; the explanation is advice only.
examples.measure: Share of planted indicators correctly named on 30 flagged claims; reviewer rating of explanation clarity.

industries.name: Capital markets and asset management
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where analysts and operations staff read filings, trade records and marketing material under time pressure and strict rules.

examples.title: Annual report risk factor change summary
examples.bottleneck: Research analysts compare risk factor sections between this year and last year by reading both in full, which is slow across a coverage list.
examples.data: Download 10-K filings for 10 public companies for two years from SEC EDGAR.
examples.approval: The analyst checks the summary against the filings before it goes into a research note.
examples.measure: Recall of hand-marked new or removed risk factors in 10 filing pairs; false change rate.

examples.title: Trade break explanation
examples.bottleneck: Operations staff compare internal trade records with broker confirmations to find why they do not match, field by field.
examples.data: Generate 200 synthetic trades and confirmations with planted breaks in price, quantity, settlement date and account.
examples.approval: An operations analyst approves the fix before any record is amended.
examples.measure: Correct break cause on 50 broken trades; no false breaks on matched trades.

examples.title: Fund marketing material compliance check
examples.bottleneck: Compliance reviewers read every fact sheet and social post for issues such as performance shown without required disclosures, and the review queue slows launches.
examples.data: Write a synthetic review checklist and generate 40 synthetic marketing pieces with planted issues.
examples.approval: A compliance officer gives final approval for every piece.
examples.measure: Recall of planted issues on 40 pieces; false flag rate on clean pieces.

examples.title: Due diligence questionnaire answer draft
examples.bottleneck: Investor relations staff answer long due diligence questionnaires by searching past answers and policies, and answers drift out of date.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic library of 150 approved past answers and 3 new synthetic questionnaires.
examples.approval: The product specialist reviews and approves every answer before the questionnaire is returned.
examples.measure: Share of drafted answers accepted without edits; reviewer rating for use of the latest approved source.

industries.name: Manufacturing and industrial
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where engineers and supervisors turn machine data, shift notes and supplier documents into decisions on the shop floor.

examples.title: Machine sensor anomaly explanation
examples.bottleneck: Maintenance engineers get many sensor alarms and must dig through trends to see which ones point to a real failure.
examples.data: Use the public NASA turbofan engine degradation dataset (C-MAPSS) or generate synthetic sensor time series with planted faults.
examples.approval: A maintenance planner decides whether to raise a work order.
examples.measure: Detection rate on planted faults; reviewer rating of explanation accuracy on 20 alarms.

examples.title: Shift handover summary
examples.bottleneck: Supervisors write shift handovers from scattered log entries and chats, so open issues are lost between shifts.
examples.data: Generate 20 synthetic shift logs with downtime events, quality holds and safety notes.
examples.approval: The outgoing supervisor edits and signs off the handover.
examples.measure: Recall of open issues across 20 logs; incoming supervisor rating of usefulness.

examples.title: Supplier quote comparison table
examples.bottleneck: Buyers copy prices, lead times, minimum order quantities and terms from quotes in different formats into a spreadsheet to compare them.
examples.data: Generate 30 synthetic supplier quotes as PDFs and emails in different layouts.
examples.approval: The buyer confirms the comparison before choosing a supplier.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 30 quotes; time to build a comparison versus by hand.

examples.title: 8D problem report first draft
examples.bottleneck: Quality engineers write 8D reports from defect data, containment notes and meeting notes, which takes days and delays the customer response.
examples.data: Generate 10 synthetic defect cases with inspection data, containment actions and team meeting notes.
examples.approval: The quality engineer edits and approves the 8D before it goes to the customer.
examples.measure: Reviewer score on 10 drafts for correct problem statement, containment and root cause sections.

industries.name: Automotive
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where field complaints, service manuals and supplier approval packages pile up faster than engineers can read them.

examples.title: Owner complaint component classifier
examples.bottleneck: Field quality engineers read owner complaints to find which component and failure mode is involved, so emerging issues are spotted late.
examples.data: Use public vehicle owner complaints from the NHTSA complaints database for a few models.
examples.approval: A field quality engineer confirms any new issue cluster before it is escalated.
examples.measure: Component label accuracy against the database component field on 300 complaints.

examples.title: Service technician repair guide lookup
examples.bottleneck: Dealer technicians search long service manuals and bulletins to find the right diagnostic steps for a symptom.
examples.data: Write a synthetic service manual section and 15 synthetic service bulletins for one vehicle system.
examples.approval: The technician follows the cited procedure and a shop foreman approves any repair outside the manual.
examples.measure: Correct procedure and citation on 30 symptom questions; correct refusal when no procedure exists.

examples.title: Supplier PPAP package completeness check
examples.bottleneck: Supplier quality engineers open every PPAP package to check that required elements are present and values match the drawing.
examples.data: Generate 15 synthetic PPAP packages as text and PDF, some with missing or mismatched elements.
examples.approval: The supplier quality engineer approves or rejects the package.
examples.measure: Recall of missing or mismatched elements on 15 packages; false flag rate.

examples.title: Engineering change impact finder
examples.bottleneck: When an engineering change is raised, engineers search requirement and test lists by hand to find what else is affected.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic set of 100 requirements, 80 test cases and 20 change requests for one vehicle subsystem.
examples.approval: The change owner confirms the impacted list before the change board meets.
examples.measure: Precision and recall of impacted items against hand labels on 20 changes.

industries.name: Aerospace and defense
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where long requirement documents, maintenance logs and supplier data need careful, traceable review.

examples.title: Maintenance log entry ATA chapter coding
examples.bottleneck: Reliability engineers code free-text maintenance log entries by system by hand before they can trend repeat defects.
examples.data: Generate 300 synthetic aircraft maintenance log entries labeled with ATA chapter.
examples.approval: A reliability engineer reviews low confidence codes before trend reports are published.
examples.measure: ATA chapter accuracy on 100 held-out entries; accuracy on the top 10 chapters.

examples.title: Solicitation compliance matrix builder
examples.bottleneck: Proposal teams read long solicitations line by line to pull every requirement into a compliance matrix, and missed requirements hurt the bid.
examples.data: Use 2 public solicitations from SAM.gov or write a synthetic solicitation.
examples.approval: The proposal manager reviews and approves the matrix before writing starts.
examples.measure: Recall and precision of requirements against a hand-built matrix for one solicitation.

examples.title: Engineering change board package summary
examples.bottleneck: Change board members receive long change packages and do not have time to read them before the meeting.
examples.data: Generate 10 synthetic engineering change packages with reason, affected parts, test results and cost impact.
examples.approval: The change originator confirms the summary is accurate before it is sent to the board.
examples.measure: Originator rating of 10 summaries; recall of cost and schedule impact items.

examples.title: Late parts check and expedite email
examples.bottleneck: Buyers check open purchase orders against supplier ship notices every day to find late parts and then write chase emails one by one.
examples.data: Generate synthetic purchase order, ship notice and need date tables in a local database.
examples.approval: The buyer approves each expedite email before it is sent.
examples.measure: Correct late part list on 3 test days; buyer rating of drafted emails.

industries.name: Retail and e-commerce
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where large catalogs, order questions and returns create repeat manual work.

examples.title: Product listing attribute and copy draft
examples.bottleneck: Merchandisers write product titles, attributes and descriptions from supplier spec sheets for thousands of items, so new items go live late.
examples.data: Generate 50 synthetic supplier spec sheets for one category such as small kitchen appliances.
examples.approval: A merchandiser approves each listing before it is published.
examples.measure: Attribute accuracy against spec sheets on 50 items; share of listings approved without edits.

examples.title: Return reason classifier
examples.bottleneck: Return comments are free text, so teams cannot see whether returns are about size, damage or wrong item without reading them.
examples.data: Generate 500 synthetic return comments, or use a public product review dataset from Hugging Face as style reference.
examples.approval: A category manager reviews the weekly breakdown before any supplier is contacted.
examples.measure: Reason label accuracy on 100 hand-labeled comments.

examples.title: Where is my order assistant
examples.bottleneck: Service agents look up the same orders across order, warehouse and carrier screens to answer where is my order questions.
examples.data: Build synthetic order, shipment and carrier tracking tables behind simple local tool functions.
examples.approval: An agent approves any refund or reshipment the assistant proposes.
examples.measure: Correct status answer on 40 test questions; correct tool calls per question; zero refunds without approval.

examples.title: Promotion price error check
examples.bottleneck: Pricing teams find promo setup mistakes, such as a discount bigger than planned, only after orders come in.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic promo plan and price feed with planted errors.
examples.approval: A pricing analyst confirms each fix before the feed is changed.
examples.measure: Recall of planted errors; false flag rate on 500 clean prices.

industries.name: Consumer packaged goods
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where trade spend, consumer feedback, forecasts and label content need checking across many products and retailers.

examples.title: Retailer deduction to promotion matcher
examples.bottleneck: Deduction analysts match retailer deductions to agreed promotions by hand, and unmatched deductions sit open for months.
examples.data: Generate synthetic promotion agreements and 200 retailer deduction lines with planted mismatches.
examples.approval: A deduction analyst approves each match or dispute before it is posted.
examples.measure: Correct match rate on 200 lines; correct dispute flags on planted mismatches.

examples.title: Consumer contact safety and quality sorter
examples.bottleneck: Consumer care agents read every contact to decide whether it is a safety, quality or general issue, and safety cases must be escalated fast.
examples.data: Generate 300 synthetic consumer emails and chat logs for food and household products.
examples.approval: A quality specialist confirms every safety flag before escalation.
examples.measure: Recall of safety cases on 300 contacts; overall label accuracy.

examples.title: Forecast miss explanation
examples.bottleneck: Demand planners spend the start of each cycle working out why last month's forecast missed, using sales, promo and stock data.
examples.data: Generate synthetic weekly sales, promo calendar, out-of-stock and forecast data for 30 products.
examples.approval: The planner accepts or rejects each explanation before forecast changes are made.
examples.measure: Correct cause on planted misses; planner rating of 20 explanations.

examples.title: Label draft allergen and claim check
examples.bottleneck: Regulatory and R&D staff check every label draft against the formula spec for allergens and claims, by reading both side by side.
examples.data: Generate 20 synthetic formula specs and matching label drafts with planted mismatches.
examples.approval: A regulatory specialist signs off each label before print.
examples.measure: Recall of planted mismatches on 20 pairs; false flag rate.

industries.name: Logistics, transport and supply chain
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where shipment documents, invoices and exception messages arrive in high volume and many formats.

examples.title: Freight invoice to rate contract check
examples.bottleneck: Freight audit staff compare carrier invoices to contracted rates and accessorials by hand, so overcharges slip through.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic rate contract and 150 carrier invoices with planted overcharges.
examples.approval: A freight auditor approves each dispute before it is sent to the carrier.
examples.measure: Recall of planted overcharges; false dispute rate.

examples.title: Shipment exception email sorter
examples.bottleneck: Control tower staff read many carrier and customer emails a day to spot delays, damage and address problems.
examples.data: Generate 400 synthetic shipment emails labeled by exception type and urgency.
examples.approval: A coordinator confirms urgent exceptions before customers are notified.
examples.measure: Exception type accuracy on 100 held-out emails; recall on urgent ones.

examples.title: Route delay explanation
examples.bottleneck: Dispatchers see late deliveries in a report but must check stop times, dwell and traffic notes to explain them to customers.
examples.data: Generate synthetic route plans and stop event logs with planted causes such as long dwell or missed slot.
examples.approval: The dispatcher approves the explanation before it is shared with a customer.
examples.measure: Correct cause on 40 late routes; dispatcher rating of clarity.

examples.title: Commercial invoice fields for customs entry
examples.bottleneck: Customs brokers retype item descriptions, values, origin and quantities from commercial invoices in many layouts.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic commercial invoices and packing lists as PDFs in different layouts.
examples.approval: A licensed broker reviews every entry before filing.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 documents; line item count accuracy.

industries.name: Energy and utilities
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where field notes, applications, meter data and tariff documents need careful reading by scarce specialists.

examples.title: Field crew work order closeout summary
examples.bottleneck: Crews leave short, inconsistent notes on completed work orders, and office staff rewrite them for asset records.
examples.data: Generate 60 synthetic crew notes with asset IDs, work done and follow-up needs.
examples.approval: A field supervisor approves the closeout before the asset record is updated.
examples.measure: Recall of follow-up needs on 60 notes; supervisor rating of summary accuracy.

examples.title: Solar interconnection application completeness
examples.bottleneck: Engineers review rooftop solar applications for missing documents and wrong values, and incomplete files bounce back and forth.
examples.data: Generate 30 synthetic interconnection applications with single-line diagram notes and equipment specs, some incomplete.
examples.approval: An interconnection engineer approves or returns the application.
examples.measure: Recall of missing or wrong items on 30 applications; false flag rate.

examples.title: High bill explanation from meter data
examples.bottleneck: Billing staff field high bill complaints by pulling interval meter data, rate changes and estimated reads to explain the bill.
examples.data: Generate synthetic hourly meter data, weather and billing records for 50 customers with planted causes.
examples.approval: A billing specialist approves the explanation and any adjustment before it reaches the customer.
examples.measure: Correct cause on 30 high bill cases; specialist rating of clarity.

examples.title: Tariff and rate schedule lookup
examples.bottleneck: Staff search long tariff books to answer questions about fees and rules, and answers are hard to check.
examples.data: Use a public tariff PDF from a state utility commission website or write a synthetic tariff book.
examples.approval: A regulatory analyst approves answers before they are used in customer letters.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and section citation on 40 questions.

industries.name: Telecom
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where network alarms, service calls and contracts create high volumes of repeat analysis.

examples.title: Network alarm storm explanation
examples.bottleneck: Network operations staff face bursts of related alarms and must work out the likely root alarm before dispatching.
examples.data: Generate synthetic alarm logs from a small network topology with planted root failures.
examples.approval: A network engineer confirms the root cause before any dispatch or config change.
examples.measure: Correct root alarm on 30 storms; time to explanation.

examples.title: Cancellation call reason classifier
examples.bottleneck: Retention teams cannot see why customers cancel because reasons are buried in free-text call notes.
examples.data: Generate 400 synthetic cancellation call notes labeled with reason.
examples.approval: A retention manager reviews the monthly reason report before offers are changed.
examples.measure: Reason accuracy on 100 held-out notes.

examples.title: Install visit notes to customer summary
examples.bottleneck: Field technicians write terse job notes, so customer care cannot tell callers what was done or what is still open.
examples.data: Generate 50 synthetic technician job notes for broadband installs and repairs.
examples.approval: The technician confirms the summary before it is attached to the account.
examples.measure: Recall of open actions on 50 notes; technician rating of accuracy.

examples.title: Enterprise SLA credit calculator
examples.bottleneck: Billing staff match outage tickets to enterprise contract SLA terms by hand to work out service credits.
examples.data: Generate synthetic enterprise contracts with SLA clauses and 100 outage tickets.
examples.approval: A billing manager approves every credit before it is applied.
examples.measure: Correct credit amount on 40 cases; correct clause matched.

industries.name: Public sector and government
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where agencies handle large volumes of requests, applications and public input with small teams.

examples.title: Public records request redaction suggestions
examples.bottleneck: Records officers read every page of responsive documents to mark personal data and exempt content before release.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic agency emails and memos with planted personal data.
examples.approval: A records officer approves every redaction before release.
examples.measure: Recall of planted personal data; over-redaction rate.

examples.title: Benefit application document extraction
examples.bottleneck: Caseworkers retype household, income and residence details from uploaded documents into the case system.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic applications with pay slips, leases and ID cards using fake data.
examples.approval: A caseworker verifies the fields and makes the eligibility decision.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 applications.

examples.title: City service request routing assistant
examples.bottleneck: Residents describe problems in their own words, and call takers must find the right department and request type in a long list.
examples.data: Build a synthetic request type catalog and generate 200 synthetic resident messages; use public city 311 data from data.gov as reference if useful.
examples.approval: The call taker confirms the request type before the ticket is created.
examples.measure: Correct request type on 100 messages; correct tool calls to the mock ticket system.

examples.title: Public comment theme summary
examples.bottleneck: Staff read thousands of public comments on a proposed rule to group themes and write a response summary.
examples.data: Download public comments on one proposed rule from regulations.gov.
examples.approval: The program lead reviews the themes against sample comments before the summary is used.
examples.measure: Coverage of hand-labeled themes on 200 comments; quote accuracy.

industries.name: Education
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where teachers and student services staff repeat the same reading and writing for many students.

examples.title: Rubric-based essay feedback draft
examples.bottleneck: Teachers write individual feedback against a rubric for every essay, which takes evenings and weekends.
examples.data: Write one rubric and generate 40 synthetic student essays at different quality levels.
examples.approval: The teacher edits the feedback and sets the grade.
examples.measure: Rubric level agreement with teacher on 40 essays; teacher edit time per essay.

examples.title: Transfer course equivalency matcher
examples.bottleneck: Registrar staff compare course descriptions from other colleges with the local catalog by hand to decide transfer credit.
examples.data: Write a synthetic local course catalog and 60 synthetic external course descriptions.
examples.approval: A registrar or faculty reviewer approves each equivalency.
examples.measure: Top-1 and top-3 match accuracy on 60 courses.

examples.title: Financial aid verification document check
examples.bottleneck: Financial aid staff compare tax forms and household statements with the student's aid application line by line.
examples.data: Generate 30 synthetic tax summaries and verification worksheets with planted mismatches.
examples.approval: A financial aid officer resolves every mismatch.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy; recall of planted mismatches on 30 files.

examples.title: Student early alert explanation
examples.bottleneck: Advisors get long lists of at-risk students but no clear reason, so outreach is generic.
examples.data: Generate synthetic learning platform activity, grades and attendance for 200 students; follow FERPA style privacy by using no real data.
examples.approval: An advisor reviews the explanation before contacting the student.
examples.measure: Correct planted cause on 40 flagged students; advisor rating of usefulness.

industries.name: Legal and professional services
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where professionals read large document sets and record time and findings under strict quality rules.

examples.title: Contract key clause extraction
examples.bottleneck: Associates read whole contracts to fill a summary of term, renewal, termination, liability cap and governing law.
examples.data: Use the public CUAD contract dataset on Hugging Face or material contracts filed on SEC EDGAR.
examples.approval: A lawyer reviews every extracted clause before the summary goes to the client.
examples.measure: Clause-level accuracy against CUAD labels on 30 contracts.

examples.title: Email privilege first-pass screen
examples.bottleneck: Review teams read every email in a production set to spot possibly privileged messages, which is slow and costly.
examples.data: Use a sample of the public Enron email dataset and hand-label 200 emails as possibly privileged or not.
examples.approval: A reviewing lawyer makes the final privilege call on every flagged email.
examples.measure: Recall of privileged emails on 200 labeled emails; false flag rate.

examples.title: Time entry narrative cleanup
examples.bottleneck: Billing staff rewrite vague time entries before invoices go out, and clients reject unclear entries.
examples.data: Generate 200 synthetic raw time entries and a synthetic client billing guideline.
examples.approval: The billing partner approves the invoice narratives.
examples.measure: Guideline compliance on 100 rewritten entries; no invented facts versus the raw entry.

examples.title: Audit sample invoice tie-out
examples.bottleneck: Audit staff match sampled ledger lines to invoices and receipts by hand and note any differences.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic ledger and 80 matching invoice PDFs with planted differences.
examples.approval: The audit senior reviews every exception before it goes into the workpapers.
examples.measure: Correct match and exception rate on 80 samples.

industries.name: Real estate and construction
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where leases, specs, submittals and site reports create a constant reading load for small teams.

examples.title: Submittal check against specification
examples.bottleneck: Project engineers compare product submittals with spec sections by hand, and review queues delay procurement.
examples.data: Write 5 synthetic spec sections and 30 synthetic product data sheets with planted deviations.
examples.approval: The architect or engineer of record approves or rejects every submittal.
examples.measure: Recall of planted deviations on 30 submittals; false flag rate.

examples.title: Commercial lease abstract
examples.bottleneck: Lease administrators read long leases to fill abstracts with rent steps, options, dates and obligations.
examples.data: Generate 15 synthetic commercial leases with amendments.
examples.approval: A lease administrator verifies the abstract before it goes into the lease system.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 15 leases, with rent steps and dates checked separately.

examples.title: Site daily report weekly summary
examples.bottleneck: Project managers read a week of daily reports from many trades to write the owner update.
examples.data: Generate 4 weeks of synthetic daily site reports with weather, crew counts, delays and safety notes.
examples.approval: The project manager edits and sends the weekly update.
examples.measure: Recall of delays and safety items; project manager rating of 4 summaries.

examples.title: Tenant maintenance request triage
examples.bottleneck: Property managers read every tenant request to set trade and urgency, and emergencies can wait in the queue.
examples.data: Generate 300 synthetic tenant requests labeled with trade and urgency.
examples.approval: A property manager confirms emergency flags before vendors are dispatched.
examples.measure: Trade accuracy and emergency recall on 100 held-out requests.

industries.name: Travel and hospitality
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where guest feedback, booking changes and group requests need fast, personal handling at volume.

examples.title: Guest review theme summary
examples.bottleneck: Hotel managers skim reviews across sites and miss repeat issues such as noise or slow check-in.
examples.data: Generate 500 synthetic guest reviews or use a public hotel review dataset from Hugging Face.
examples.approval: The general manager reviews the themes before actions are assigned.
examples.measure: Coverage of hand-labeled themes on 200 reviews; quote accuracy.

examples.title: Booking change assistant with fare rules
examples.bottleneck: Agents look up booking, fare rules and availability across screens to handle simple date changes.
examples.data: Build synthetic booking, fare rule and availability tables behind simple local tool functions.
examples.approval: An agent approves any fee waiver or refund before it is applied.
examples.measure: Correct change outcome on 40 scenarios; zero fee waivers without approval.

examples.title: Group and event request intake
examples.bottleneck: Sales managers read long event request emails to pull dates, room blocks, meeting space and food needs before they can quote.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic group and event request emails.
examples.approval: The sales manager confirms the requirements before a proposal is sent.
examples.measure: Field-level accuracy on 40 requests.

examples.title: Night audit discrepancy explanation
examples.bottleneck: Night auditors and accountants chase differences between room revenue, postings and payments every morning.
examples.data: Generate synthetic folio, posting and payment records with planted discrepancies.
examples.approval: The accountant approves every correcting entry.
examples.measure: Correct cause on planted discrepancies; false alarm rate.

industries.name: Technology and software (SaaS)
industries.blurb: AI POCs usually help where support, engineering and sales teams handle repeat questions and turn messy input into structured work.

examples.title: Support ticket to bug report draft
examples.bottleneck: Support engineers rewrite customer tickets into bug reports with steps, expected and actual result, and engineering still sends many back for detail.
examples.data: Generate 60 synthetic support tickets with logs and screenshots described in text.
examples.approval: A support engineer approves the bug report before it is filed.
examples.measure: Engineering rating of 30 drafts for reproducibility; share sent back for more detail.

examples.title: Release notes from merged changes
examples.bottleneck: Product managers write release notes by reading merged pull requests, and user-facing changes get missed.
examples.data: Use merged pull request titles and descriptions from a public open source repository on GitHub.
examples.approval: The product manager edits and publishes the notes.
examples.measure: Recall of user-facing changes against hand-labeled pull requests for 3 releases.

examples.title: Security questionnaire answers from policies
examples.bottleneck: Security staff answer long customer security questionnaires by searching policies and old answers, which slows deals.
examples.data: Write a synthetic set of security policies and 2 synthetic questionnaires.
examples.approval: The security lead approves every answer before it is returned.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and citation on 80 questions; correct 'needs review' rate when no policy covers it.

examples.title: Account usage drop explanation
examples.bottleneck: Account managers see a health score drop but not why, so renewal calls start without a clear story.
examples.data: Generate synthetic product usage events, support tickets and seat counts for 100 accounts with planted causes.
examples.approval: The account manager reviews the explanation before any customer outreach.
examples.measure: Correct planted cause on 30 accounts; account manager rating of usefulness.

industries.name: Any industry: back-office functions
industries.blurb: Back-office teams in every industry have the same repeat work in finance, HR, procurement, IT, sales and program management.

examples.title: Invoice exception three-way match
examples.bottleneck: Accounts payable clerks resolve invoices that do not match the purchase order and goods receipt by checking each line by hand.
examples.data: Generate synthetic purchase orders, goods receipts and 150 invoices with planted price and quantity differences.
examples.approval: An accounts payable lead approves each exception resolution before payment.
examples.measure: Correct exception reason on planted cases; false exception rate on clean invoices.

examples.title: HR policy assistant for employees
examples.bottleneck: HR staff answer the same leave, travel and benefits questions by email every day.
examples.data: Write a synthetic employee handbook and 50 synthetic employee questions.
examples.approval: HR approves the answer set before launch, and any question about a personal case goes to an HR person.
examples.measure: Answer correctness and citation on 50 questions; correct handoff rate on personal cases.

examples.title: Supplier contract review against playbook
examples.bottleneck: Procurement and legal staff read supplier paper to find clauses that differ from the company playbook, and simple deals wait in the queue.
examples.data: Write a synthetic negotiation playbook and generate 20 synthetic supplier contracts with planted deviations.
examples.approval: A contract manager approves each proposed redline before it goes to the supplier.
examples.measure: Recall of planted deviations on 20 contracts; false flag rate.

examples.title: IT ticket triage and routing
examples.bottleneck: Service desk staff read every ticket to set category, priority and team, and misrouted tickets bounce between teams.
examples.data: Generate 500 synthetic IT tickets labeled with category, priority and team.
examples.approval: A service desk lead confirms any ticket marked high priority.
examples.measure: Team routing accuracy on 100 held-out tickets; high priority recall.

examples.title: Sales call notes to CRM update
examples.bottleneck: Sellers skip CRM updates after calls, so next steps, contacts and deal stage are out of date.
examples.data: Generate 40 synthetic call transcripts and a mock CRM with simple local tool functions.
examples.approval: The seller reviews the proposed CRM changes and clicks approve before anything is written.
examples.measure: Correct field updates on 40 calls; zero writes without approval.

examples.title: Program status report draft
examples.bottleneck: Program managers spend hours each week collecting updates from trackers and notes to write the status report.
examples.data: Generate a synthetic task tracker export, risk log and 4 weeks of team meeting notes.
examples.approval: The program manager edits and sends the report.
examples.measure: Recall of overdue items and new risks; program manager edit time per report.
